title: Rotate and flip the complete image
summary: Turn screenshots clockwise, counterclockwise or 180 degrees, and flip them horizontally or vertically with one-step Undo.

Added: Image > Rotate quarter and half turns, plus Arrange > Flip Image Horizontal/Vertical. Exact pixel mappings preserve transparency without resampling.
Flatten confirmation when objects are present. Cancel preserves the document; one Undo restores the editable objects and original dimensions.
Verified: 126 Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy. All five native saved outputs match independent pixel mappings across 1,280,000 pixels.
Original-source retention, no-op Redo, invalid input rollback, real save/reopen and native clipboard comparisons.

limitations: These commands transform the whole image and flatten editable objects after confirmation. Selected-object rotation and flips remain unfinished.
Custom image angles, grouping, interactive crop and full reference UI parity remain unfinished.
Unsigned Windows x64 alpha. Testing uses original synthetic fixtures; full Snagit behavioral parity is not claimed.
